style: MineWorld production environment modeling reference sheet. STRICT STYLE: low-poly chunky pixel-textured 3D fantasy dungeon, crisp square pixel clusters, flat planar blocks, broad bevel edges only, Minecraft Dungeons architectural readability, no photoreal textures, no painterly blur, no characters, no HUD. Warm ivory sheet, dark navy English labels, thin antique-gold separators. Functional modular level design, open roofs for top views, generous open playable center; decorations only on walls or existing obstacle islands. All panels depict identical buildable geometry in TRUE ORTHOGRAPHIC TOP / FRONT SECTION / RIGHT SECTION, with optional small isometric overview. Three-unit-wide unobstructed entrances and corridors; vertical grandeur via peripheral 3-6 unit structures, never obstruct arena. No new pits or stairs in the walkable area.
floors: PRESSURE FORECOURT
coal slate blocks, dull copper tubes, restrained amber furnace light with cool gray daylight

pressure-ring 15x13 cut corners, two broad side steam lanes with center and both end crossings unobstructed. Copper valves on wall alcoves, squat paired tanks, horizontal elevated perimeter pipes. Secondary regular rooms use four obstacle plinths (pillar-court), staggered metal barricades (broken-bulwark), divided gallery with cross passage (split-gallery), flanking ring. Show these four generic room masks as small top mini-plans below. Main identity open industrial entry yard, low tanks and many valve fixtures.
TRANSPORT GALLERIES
coal slate and iron, weathered ochre copper, warm amber lamps, muted rusty canvas

impact-yard 16x13: open elongated test yard, clearly distinct breakable barrier segments inside existing obstacle line, side route intact. Tall overhead crane frame along perimeter only, stacked cargo in wall bays, transport rails flush with floor leading along existing corridors. Extra inset top and side of breakable panel, NOT a new obstacle. Main identity hoist beams and freight bays.
RESONANCE WORKSHOP
blue-gray slate, dull copper braces, restrained teal energy glass accents, soft amber lamps

resonance-workshop 15x13 with supply linkage machines ONLY in wall alcoves and existing obstacle posts; prism-gallery 15x12 with intermittent cover and broad connecting route. TWO ROOM ROWS each TOP / FRONT SECTION / RIGHT SECTION. Small top mini inset of clear corridor joining these rooms. Tall polygonal resonance coils, triangular prism housings behind railings at perimeter; open combat floor. Main identity vertical coils and glass prisms.
OVERLOAD NEXUS
deep charcoal iron, oxidized copper, restrained red-orange vents and amber warning lamps

foundry-combination 16x13 main room, overload-trial 17x15 optional side room. TWO ROOM ROWS TOP FRONT SECTION RIGHT SECTION. Preserve wide routes and original obstacle islands; no lethal floors. Dense peripheral pipe junctions, twin pressure stacks, optional small central device with large open ring of space around it. Main identity intersecting overhead wall pipes, paired pressure towers, warm industrial backlight.
GREAT FURNACE CORE
dark basalt iron, antique copper, strong localized molten orange furnace openings, distant cool teal sealed tomb doorway

furnace-arena 19x17 cut-corner boss hall, open continuous center and perimeter walkway, enormous closed furnace facade OUTSIDE rear playable wall, two massive flanking smokestacks outside room. foundry-combination 13x11 short L-shaped approach room shown in second compact row of top/front/right. Small quiet exit door with ancient bell silhouette and teal light bridges next chapter. NO lava over playable floor. Main identity monumental furnace and asymmetric chimney skyline.
SILENT TOMB CORRIDORS
coal black #20262b, bone gray #aaa38e, old stone green #506966, muted gold #a08048, restrained cold cyan #72c6c3 lamps

sanctum-echo 15x13 cut-corner and cross-hall variants; sanctum-procession 18x11 L-shaped broad funeral lane. TWO ROWS TOP FRONT SECTION RIGHT SECTION, second echo shape inset. Low bone niches along walls, short fractured rib arches, half-buried broken bells outside walking lanes, worn funeral cloth. Low shallow water sheen only along edges no movement effects. Main identity quiet low crypt and repeated square niche rhythm.
FUNERAL COURTS
bone gray sandstone, weathered old stone green, pale gray slabs, muted gold, sparse cold cyan votives

sanctum-inscription 16x14 three-leaf court with wide outer pockets for placing marks, sanctum-ritual 15x15 three-leaf with two existing ritual platforms at opposite outer sides. TWO ROWS TOP FRONT SECTION RIGHT SECTION. Omit dynamic danger indicators; geometric inlays subdued. Leaning memorial tablets in perimeter recesses, low stone sarcophagi, ribbed open arcades. Small L-shaped procession connecting hall inset. Main identity leaf-shaped courts and funerary tablets.
HALL OF A THOUSAND NAMES
bone stone, coal shadow recesses, old jade green banners, faded gold trim, cyan niche candles

sanctum-blade 16x13 crescent with broad inner chord shortcut, sanctum-ritual three-leaf court and sanctum-inscription leaf court shown as variants. Main crescent TOP FRONT SECTION RIGHT SECTION plus compact 3view ritual module section. Stacked perimeter bone niches, many blank square name plaques, tall broken rib pilasters. Existing low tomb obstacles ONLY, no new coffin in central floor. Main identity layered ossuary walls and crescent procession.
HANGING BELL COURTS
bone gray, cold green patina, dark green funeral cloth, antique dull brass bells, dim cyan lanterns

sanctum-trial 17x15 asymmetric four-leaf court with open crossing center, echo cross-hall16x14, blade crescent and procession L-shaped variants shown as small clear top plans. Main trial TOP FRONT SECTION RIGHT SECTION. Large upside-down bells hang from peripheral broken stone gantries OUTSIDE movement footprint, broken but thick reusable chain links. No ceiling blocking camera. Main identity silhouette of suspended bells and higher rib arches.
NAMELESS THRONE
pale bone sandstone lit by cool cyan side lamps, dark coal alcoves, restrained tarnished gold, desaturated green cloth

sanctum-throne 19x19 octagonal boss arena, continuous wide outer ring and open center, exactly THREE low square inscription slots on outer sides, rear huge cracked bell and empty throne facade OUTSIDE playable arena. procession 14x11 cut-corner approach in small TOP FRONT RIGHT row. Monumental broken rib arch behind throne, side ossuary towers, ample clear fight space. Main identity open octagonal sanctuary and silent giant bell.
